message: How are you my dear brother I am a choir leader My name is Stephen Mark and I'm 32nd year old I do ministry work in Ghana. I want others to join me so that together we can bring glory to God.And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he hath commanded us.For in the word of the Lord it is written in the  first John, verses 7 through 10: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is from God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God. He who does not love does not know God, for God is love.  In this was manifested the love of God among us, because God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him. Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.And we should also love each other and stay connected to each other.And I ask you to pray for me, my dear brother
reply: 📖 1 John 3:23; 4:7-10: Amen! 🙏
reply: 👌 The servant of God is doing good 💯 through the grace of God, because 📖 all things work together for good to them that love God and are called according to the purpose of God! (Romans 8:28) However, please pray that the servant of God will be perfectly loving and healed🙏
reply: 🙏 The servant of God is called Jared Patten Mathis - "When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch." Genesis 5:18 🤝
reply: The servant of God is about 37 years old
reply: 🙏 All glory to God ❤️✝️🕊️ ! 
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : 
🙏 May the LORD have His will done! 🕊️ May the LORD lead others to provide you with an abundance of prayer! May the LORD always bless your ministry, your worship, the people of Ghana, you, your family, your church and your country exceedingly abundantly more than anyone can ask or think! Amen! 🙏
